title: Rename "bumper" inputs to "shoulder" in OpenXR Steam Frame interaction profile
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

The "bumper" inputs in the Steam Frame interaction profile (the secondary trigger button) has been renamed to "shoulder" to be inline with other OpenXR specifications.

The SteamVR runtime both for PCVR and on Steam Frame has been updated to accept both old and new names, so it should be safe for us to adopt the  new name.
